notes: Four university-layer documents (2023 Provost principles PDF, syllabus-guidance page with two templates, genai.usf.edu university-guidance page which repeats the principles, genai.usf.edu course-guidance page); both coders marked all four delegates. Pairing was by source passage, not position: in the syllabus 'Violation consequences' sentence and the 'ask students to detail' passage the coders listed items in a different order, and in the guidance and course pages a few units were offset, so I re-paired them before computing shares (shares are over the 114 matched units). Main disagreements: (1) phase, the largest (principle statements coded during-work by A and general by B; misuse-list items coded when-misuse vs during-work); resolved by the rule that a duty applying at the point of using AI is during-work, definitions, availability notes and background are general, and items listed under 'Violation consequences' are when-misuse. (2) unit_stance on conditions and duties: 'require' or 'encourage' used for citation, disclosure and discussion duties; resolved to neutral where the unit takes no position on AI use, and to permit where it conditions a use the acceptable-use template allows. (3) modality must vs should vs informs on guidance-page text ('be sure to review', 'will be subject to academic penalties', 'serves as a framework'): consequence and descriptive statements informs, advice to instructors should, stated responsibilities must. (4) policy_type, 9 units: P31 vs P29 (understanding tool limits, P31); P36 vs P10 (uncertainty is no excuse, P36); P01/P29 vs P19 for AI-generated content in submitted work (P19); P83 vs P35 (assessments and learning outcomes, P83); P103 vs P47 (chatbot notice, P103); P04 vs P09 (assignment-level permission, P04); P17 vs P51 for ban exceptions (UNCOVERED). Only-A units (4): per-assignment adjustment, accuracy responsibility, citation-format option, and a library copyright pointer, all real statements and kept. Only-B units (16): principle sentences A skipped (human judgment, bias basis, acknowledgement of sources, transparency rationale, which also repeat in the guidance page), the 'responsibly use' condition, inaccurate-output misuse, and course-page statements (aligning with learning goals, reduced reliance on high-stakes exams, specific permitted uses); all real and kept. No units dropped.
